title: Rabbi Levitas of Yavneh
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: His precious saying has been preserved for us in Avot 4:4, where he said: "Be very, very humble of spirit, for the hope of man is the worm." There is also a great saying of his in Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer, chapter 23; and there, in chapter 52, he said that gray hair is splendor and honor for the elders, like a crown, which is the glory upon the head of a king.
